problems.label: thm:main-two
problems.statement: Rigidity for r = 2: no admissible rational-circle point for A_{k,l;m,n}; proved by exact certificate for k+l <= N.

problems.label: conj:torsion
problems.statement: Every rational point of every solution variety lies on a torsion coset of a proper subtorus.
